title: Skip Atwater's contact in Australia sees UFOs going in and out of Mount Zeil
summary: Lyn Buchanan tells of Skip Atwater's contact in Australia sees UFOs going in and out of Mount Zeil, about unspecified at Mount Zeil, Australia, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: It's the most boring job I've ever had if it weren't for all those UFOs going in and out of Mount Zeal would have anything to do.

plain: A former Army sergeant, Lyn Buchanan, relays a story from a man named Skip Atwater about a contact of his who worked near Mount Zeil, a mountain in central Australia. Buchanan says the contact called it the most boring job he ever had, except for all the UFOs going in and out of the mountain, which, if true, would suggest something hidden inside it.
